title: Little Pixel Art Animation LOFI
author: ConceptNext5110
selftext:
**model:** Optus 5.5, X-High

**Story:** Girl finally found the boy, who sits at the roof with his Shiba dog ( past away 1 year ago) - that's where they always hang out. Dog warms the surrounding, including the boy, in contrast with the dark/cold blue light from the megacity of Tokyo.  

But, In the morning, the dog leaves. 

**Feature**: day/night, character movable(but not quite polished), audio mixer(train moves, wind blowing, etc)

**What Doesn Work Very Well:** Slow and not good at drawing humans

**What's Interesting:** compare this to the old way of generating pixel art animation, sprite sheet, is reference image -> difussion video generation -> down sample.  

**Here is the link:** [https://claude.ai/artifact/HTqHAg8ovaDwcFNTKvvA2k](https://claude.ai/artifact/HTqHAg8ovaDwcFNTKvvA2k) 

double click for full screen, press 'h' to bring up the HUD.
